study type: Cross-sectional study nested in a cohort
exposure: Kangaroo Method participation (first and second stages vs. first stage only)
cohort: The study included 114 newborns weighing <=1800 g and their mothers from the Neonatal Unit of a Brazilian university hospital.
finding: The kangaroo group demonstrated a higher rate of exclusive breastfeeding at hospital discharge, and both kangaroo care and breastfeeding self-efficacy independently and positively influenced exclusive breastfeeding, but breastfeeding self-efficacy did not act as a mediator in this association.
cross-section timing: At hospital discharge (data collected between September 2018 and March 2020)
